text:
maria.k: quick sync — we need to lock down the launch scope for 'compliance telemetry v1' (audit search, retention tiers, legal-hold escape). proposal attached in thread below. feedback pls :eyes:

tom.product: high level — customers asked for per-tenant retention + emergency legal-hold. can we ship a UI toggle for legal-hold in v1?

sre-jay: i'd prefer v1 to focus on API + exportable snapshots. UI toggle adds product polish but also ownership and auth edges.

security-ana: reqs from security: immutable append-only audit store, signed metadata, and per-tenant retention TTLs. SOC2 wants tamper evidence and export proof.

legal-jd: legal-hold needs ability to freeze deletion for a tenant across retention tiers. also audit trail of who toggled the hold + time.

maria.k: suggestion: ship API-first v1 (create/append/search/export, retention policy object) + a read-only UI for now. legal-hold UI can be v1.1. that reduces auth surface.

tom.product: ok. what are minimal launch criteria? propose: 
- index last 90 days for quick search, fallback to cold archive for >90d 
- retention policy CRUD via API + per-tenant override 
- legal-hold toggle via API 
- evidence export (signed bundle) within 24h 
- SOC2 checklist item covered (audit evidence export flow documented)

security-ana: add: demo for SOC2 reviewer showing append-only proof and signed export keys. include threat model notes.

sre-jay: operational SLOs we should commit to for v1: search p95 < 300ms for index window, export job queuing latency < 1h, restore from cold <= 24h. these affect infra cost.

maria.k: agreed. we should also include quantifiable success metrics: 5 pilot customers onboarded, no critical security findings, and <20% increase to hosting cost for telemetry.

tom.product: prioritization asks: CTO customers want BYOK keystore integration in v1. legal customers say BYOK is critical. can we scope a BYOK handshake MVP?

security-ana: BYOK full integration is heavy. MVP idea: allow customer-provided keys for export signing only (KMS-wrap) while we keep internal keys for live indexing. that limits attack surface and unblocks legal requirements for evidence signing.

legal-jd: export-signed-by-customer-key is usually acceptable for contracts; require clear contract language.

maria.k: proposal updated: BYOK-signed-exports MVP + API-first retention + legal-hold API. BYOK-for-storage deferred to v2.

sre-jay: noted. we need runbook for key rotation and emergency key-escrow if customer loses keys. ops burden needs estimate.

maria.k: action items: @sre-jay estimate infra cost + SLO tradeoffs (ETA EOD Wed), @security-ana write SOC2 demo checklist (ETA Fri), @legal-jd draft contract wording for signed exports (ETA Fri), @tom.product prepare pilot list and customer comms (ETA Mon).

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch compliance/telemetry-v1 (sha: a1b2c3) — staging env updated :rocket:

tom.product: one more Q — retention UI: we'll surface retention tier names and TTLs in console, but CRUD via API only. product ok?

maria.k: yes. keep UI read-only for v1 so PMs can demo without adding auth work. v1.1 will add write.

security-ana: sample retention policy JSON for API v1:

```
{
  "policy_id": "default-90",
  "description": "index last 90d, cold archive thereafter",
  "index_ttl_days": 90,
  "archive_ttl_days": 3650,
  "legal_hold": false,
  "signed_exports": {
    "enabled": true,
    "signing_key_type": "customer-kms-or-our-key",
    "signature_algorithm": "rsa-pss-sha256"
  }
}
```

maria.k: nice. include that in the spec doc.

sre-jay: minor infra note — cold archive will be S3 glacier-like; restore times may vary, mark as 'best effort' if vendor glacier used.

legal-jd: can we add an audit field to exports: "evidence_bundle_id", "signed_by", "timestamp", "keystore_fingerprint" — for legal chain-of-custody.

security-ana: yep, include keystore_fingerprint and signed_manifest in bundle.

maria.k: final check — scope locked for v1: API-first retention policy CRUD, legal-hold API, signed-export MVP (customer-provided key allowed for signing), read-only console, SOC2 demo checklist. everything else to v1.1. any objections?

tom.product: thumbs up from product. :+1:

sre-jay: +1 pending cost estimate.

legal-jd: +1 pending contract language.

security-ana: +1.

maria.k: thanks all — i'll update the spec and open a tracking PR and a pilot onboarding doc. closing thread once PR is up.
